title: SaaS SEO Analyzer input
description: Give one or more public URLs and pick how deep to go. Bare domains get https:// added.

urls.title: URLs
urls.description: Pages to audit, or the start pages of the sites to crawl in Site audit mode. Up to 1,000 per run.

mode.title: Mode
mode.description: Page audit returns the full report for each URL. Quick score returns score, grade, warnings and the top five fixes only, at a lower price. Site audit crawls a bounded sample of each site and adds cross-page findings.
enumTitles: Page audit – full report per URL
Quick score – score and top fixes per URL
Site audit – bounded crawl of each site

maxPages.title: Max pages per site
maxPages.description: Site audit only. Upper limit of pages fetched and charged per start URL.
maxPages.sectionDescription: These settings are ignored in Page audit and Quick score modes.

maxDepth.title: Max link depth
maxDepth.description: How many clicks away from the start URL the crawl may go. Pages listed in the sitemap are sampled regardless of depth.

useSitemap.title: Read XML sitemaps
useSitemap.description: Use robots.txt and sitemap.xml to find pages and to report orphan candidates.

respectRobots.title: Respect robots.txt
respectRobots.description: Skip pages that robots.txt disallows for the SaaSSEOAnalyzer user agent. Turn off only for sites you own.

includeSubdomains.title: Include subdomains
includeSubdomains.description: Treat subdomains such as docs.example.com as part of the same site.
